## Key conventions

Follow the Defra Software Development Standards defined by https://defra.github.io/software-development-standards. In particular:
- [JavaScript standards](https://defra.github.io/software-development-standards/standards/javascript_standards)
- [Logging standards](https://defra.github.io/software-development-standards/standards/logging_standards)
- [Node standards](https://defra.github.io/software-development-standards/standards/node_standards)
- [Security standards](https://defra.github.io/software-development-standards/standards/security_standards)
- [Container standards](https://defra.github.io/software-development-standards/standards/container_standards/)

## Guides

Follow the Defra Software Development Guides defined by https://defra.github.io/software-development-standards. In particular:
- [Docker guidance](https://defra.github.io/software-development-standards/guides/docker_guidance/)

Follow the GOV.UK Design System guidance defined by https://design-system.service.gov.uk/get-started/ for UI/UX elements.
Always use components from the included package `govuk-frontend` when they are available; The documentation can be found in https://frontend.design-system.service.gov.uk/
